scope: Full episode 1 procedural 3D asset integration, including architecture and surfaces. Earlier prop review remains historical.

manualReview.method: Sampled four catalogue contact sheets covering all 45 entries, two architecture turntables, nine room views and actual gameplay captures. Existing props and actors retain their earlier review.
findingsResolved: Raised doorway header clearance to 2.30 world units above floor for tallest actor and motion allowance
Replaced bevelled adjoining floor tiles with square-plan slabs to remove corner notches
Trimmed corridor floor underlap to exposed 4-unit horizontal and 6-unit vertical map gaps
Grounded three document trays on reception counter
Separated I02 layered label from stamp board and restored board in P11
Grounded stored and recovered boat and ledger on actual support surfaces
Widened packing tables and separated recovered evidence while preserving kit dimensions
Separated packing tables from exit doors and maintenance pipes
Separated maintenance supply cabinet from pipe and courtyard planter from valve
